comment: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme, as the RFC Editor publishes it. Only Appendix B is vendored: lines 581 to 671 of the published text, byte for byte (`sed -n 581,671p rfc8785.txt`), because the rest is not needed and its Authors' Addresses would put personal email addresses in the tree (PV-01). Its table (IEEE 754 bits and the JSON text each must serialize to) is the number oracle: generators/snapshot's jcsnumbers serializes every row and parses each expected text back to the same bits, and writes the rows it held to appendix-b.txt (GN-01).
standard: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS), IETF, June 2020
